sentences.en: My sister works at a school for visually impaired children.
sentences.zh: 我妹妹在为视力受损儿童工作的学校工作。

sentences.en: Your insight is poor and your judgment is impaired.
sentences.zh: 你的洞察力差，判断力受到了损害。

sentences.en: The snow impaired Mustafa’s ability to hear anyone’s footsteps.
sentences.zh: 雪模糊了穆斯塔法听到任何人脚步声的能力。
